statement_or_rule: Contains fruit enzymes (citrus/orange peel)

prohibited_uses: Do not apply to repellents, Silver, Rust Remover, Drain Cleaner, Mould Remover, Ink Remover, Silicone Spray, Pepper Spray, Hand Wash, Stain Remover, Helmet Cleaner, Fabric Coat

statement_or_rule: Ingredients listed in plain words on the label
limitations: Verified on 29 of 31 labels; Fabric Coat label has placeholder ingredients; Descaler label unread
prohibited_uses: Do not say 'every product' until all labels checked

statement_or_rule: Made in India
limitations: Own plant; GST invoices

prohibited_uses: Do not use anywhere

statement_or_rule: Kids safe / Pet safe / Baby & pet safe
limitations: Labels say keep out of reach of children and do not spray on pets
prohibited_uses: Do not use anywhere

statement_or_rule: Biodegradable / Septic safe / Organic
limitations: No test report; brochure shows an Organic badge
prohibited_uses: Do not use until tested

statement_or_rule: Disinfectant (Lemongrass Floor Cleaner name)
limitations: No germ-kill test
prohibited_uses: Rename or test

statement_or_rule: Repels lizards / rats / ants without killing
limitations: No efficacy report; CIB&RC status unknown
prohibited_uses: Ads only after regulatory answer

statement_or_rule: Keeps cockroaches, mosquitoes, flies, ants and spiders away (Multipurpose label)
limitations: Most regulated claim type; CIB&RC status unknown
prohibited_uses: Do not use in ads or site copy

statement_or_rule: Rating and family count: 4.5 / 2,500+ families, Best Seller, Top Rated (product pages)
limitations: Owner confirmed as source of truth 21 Nov 2026; homepage says 2,000+ and brochure 4.6 / 5,000+
prohibited_uses: Use one count everywhere

limitations: Cloth at 99 is inferred; confirm

statement_or_rule: Performance index scores vs conventional cleaners (brochure)
limitations: Brochure itself says illustrative, pending lab validation
prohibited_uses: Do not use

statement_or_rule: Certifications: ISO 9001:2015, GMP, DPIIT, MSME
limitations: Numbers and expiry dates not on file
prohibited_uses: Show badges only with certificate numbers

statement_or_rule: UGC reels: owner thinks none have run on Meta (21 Nov 2026)
limitations: New reels will be filmed in-house; get written consent from anyone on camera

statement_or_rule: Customer reviews, names and photos in ads
limitations: No written permission
prohibited_uses: Do not use in ads

statement_or_rule: Shelf life: best before 12 months from manufacturing date
Approvals: Ashutosh approves ads, website changes, discounts and refunds

limitations: Conflict; no leak/damage clause

statement_or_rule: Delivery: banner says free on all orders, 3-6 business days; policy says charges at checkout, ship within 2 business days
limitations: Conflict

statement_or_rule: Cancellation only before the order ships
Legal Metrology: labels carry template MRP 999, batch ASCF208, mfg Aug 2026 and phone XXXXX
limitations: Confirm printed labels show real values

statement_or_rule: Marketplace reviews on getnon.in: show as "Reviews from Amazon and Flipkart", not as verified getnon.in purchases
limitations: Omit lines claiming kids/pet safety, chlorine or caustic content; IS 19000:2022 online reviews standard

limitations: 28 of 31 proposed prices exceed current MRP
prohibited_uses: Do not upload Pricing Sheet prices before MRPs change

statement_or_rule: Not every NoN product is enzyme or plant based: Mould Remover (active chlorine), Drain Cleaner (caustic granules), Rust Remover (mineral acids), Ink Remover (solvents, flammable), Silicone Spray, Pepper Spray
limitations: From label ingredients
prohibited_uses: Do not call the whole range natural, plant-based or bio-enzyme; claim per product only

statement_or_rule: Fabric Coat back label carries placeholder text: ingredients and description "to be confirmed with final formula"
limitations: Label not final
prohibited_uses: Do not print or sell with this label; do not advertise until ingredients are confirmed

statement_or_rule: Glycerine Hand Wash label shows "Cosmetic Mfg. Lic. No.: ___" blank
limitations: Hand wash is regulated as a cosmetic; licence number needed on label
prohibited_uses: Do not reprint labels without the licence number

statement_or_rule: Pepper Spray: self-defence product; label: severe eye and skin irritant, toxic if swallowed, extremely flammable propellant
limitations: Ad platforms restrict weapons and self-defence sprays
prohibited_uses: Check Meta ad policy before any ad; keep out of kits

statement_or_rule: Label SKU code NON-SIL-400 (Silicone Spray) clashes with NON-SIL-200 (Silver Cleaner)
limitations: Two products share the SIL prefix
prohibited_uses: Rename one code before reprint

statement_or_rule: Bathroom Cleaner label: Not for marble or natural stone
